purpose: Fresh protagonist design, not texture variation
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Design a COMPLETELY NEW original protagonist candidate for a warm magic-academy narrative card game called GRIMOIRE. One character only, waist-up portrait on plain warm ivory background. A youthful male academy student about 15-16, distinctly ordinary curious schoolboy rather than an idealized idol, slim adolescent shoulders, broad softly squared face, small attentive dark eyes, visible expressive eyebrows, short blunt uneven charcoal-black haircut with an off-center part and exposed ears, NO fluffy brown hair, NO cowlick, NO teal scarf. Slightly mischievous closed-mouth half-smile. Costume is practical student wear: ivory collar shirt with sleeves rolled to forearms, muted ink-blue sleeveless buttoned waistcoat, a small ochre neck ribbon tied simply, short dark blue shoulder cape draped over one shoulder and fastened with a plain round brass clasp, sparse functional stitching, NO ornamental gold filigree. Pose upright three-quarter view, looking slightly to viewer's left; one hand holding a single blank-faced spell card loosely at shoulder height, other forearm resting at waist with a thin closed notebook tucked UNDER THE ARM, NOT hugged front and center. Both hands fully visible anatomically clear. Entire head, both shoulders and elbows within canvas; bottom crop just below waist, no legs. Artwork should look like restrained ink-and-flat-color illustrated adventure comics: visibly intentional variable-weight dark ink outlines, simplified expressive features and shapes, matte flat color fills with one hard-edged shadow, very little texture, no airbrush gradients, no rendered glossy eyes or hair, no watercolor filter, no generic pretty anime face. High quality character design with a strong distinctive readable silhouette. Limited palette ivory, ink blue, charcoal, ochre. Purely 2D non-pixel illustration. No backdrop, no text, no labels, no logo, no UI frame, no glowing effects, no star symbols, no extra people. The card is a prop for posture only and carries no readable text or gameplay numbers. This is a fresh design candidate, not an edit of any earlier portrait.
